capabilityDomains.name: AVD Infrastructure
capabilityDomains.summary: Host pools, session hosts, gateways, and the AVD control plane — in a safe investigation order.

capabilityDomains.name: Networking
capabilityDomains.summary: DNS, routing, firewalls, and name resolution as first-class fault domains for VDI connectivity.

capabilityDomains.name: TRM, Escalation & Ops
capabilityDomains.summary: Use TRM, MIM, and the out-of-hours support model: escalate, update, and hand over rather than treating the ticket as a solo puzzle.

capabilityDomains.name: Proxy Solution
capabilityDomains.summary: Secure Access / Prisma, inspection, and connector path issues between the desktop and the application.

capabilityDomains.name: Vendor Management
capabilityDomains.summary: Know when a Microsoft or other vendor case is appropriate, and what evidence to prepare.

capabilityDomains.name: Platform Troubleshooting
capabilityDomains.summary: Establish impact, use runbooks, and follow evidence before changing the platform.

capabilityDomains.name: M365 Stack
capabilityDomains.summary: Entra ID, Conditional Access, and other Microsoft 365 dependencies that sit in front of the desktop.

readinessCriteria.notes: Ready needs one scenario per spoke, released, with mandatory and safety-critical criteria at Demonstrated (2) or above. A high domain average must not hide an unmet criterion. Workplace tickets cannot replace a spoke. Completion of attempts is not readiness.
